channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Israeli FM hopes for better ties with Türkiye
item.description: Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar has said he hopes for an improvement in relations between Ankara and Tel Aviv, which have deteriorated since the outbreak of the Gaza war, but stressed that any progress depends entirely on the Turkish side.

item.title: Turkish travel association seeks to block access to major online booking platforms
item.description: The Association of Turkish Travel Agencies (TÜRSAB) has initiated legal proceedings seeking to block access to 10 foreign-based online travel platforms, including Airbnb, Expedia, Hotels.com and Agoda, citing violations of Turkish regulations.

item.title: Istanbul court opens trial of seven CHP mayors
item.description: An Istanbul court on Jan. 27 opened the first hearing in a bribery and bid-rigging case involving seven mayors from the main opposition Republican People’s Party (CHP).

item.title: Ankara, Paris discuss ways to advance Türkiye-EU ties
item.description: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan and his French counterpart, Jean-Noel Barrot, discussed ways to overcome current freeze in Türkiye-EU ties, including modernization of the customs union and visa liberalization, as well as to strengthen the security of the European continent in a key meeting in the Turkish capital Ankara on Jan. 27.

item.title: Türkiye embarks on 10th National Antarctic Science Expedition
item.description: Türkiye has launched its 10th National Antarctic Scientific Expedition, deploying a team of researchers to the continent to carry out vital climate and environmental studies in one of the world’s harshest and most remote environments.

item.title: EU-India trade pact gives Brussels lift after US tensions
item.description: The European Union sealed a landmark trade agreement with India on Jan. 27, a diplomatic win for Brussels as it tries to widen its partnerships after a bruising spell of tension with Washington.

item.title: Türkiye to deepen trade, investment ties with Nigeria, says minister
item.description: Trade Minister Ömer Bolat said Türkiye will deepen cooperation with Nigeria in industry, trade, investment and production, as Ankara hosted President Bola Ahmed Tinubu for an official visit.

item.title: Erdoğan, Trump discuss Syria, Gaza peace board in phone call
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan and U.S. President Donald Trump spoke by phone on Tuesday about developments in Syria and work tied to the Gaza “Board of Peace.”

item.title: Sharaa to meet Putin in Moscow as Russia shifts forces in Syria
item.description: Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa will meet Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow on Wednesday, the Kremlin said, in his second trip to Russia since Assad’s ouster in late 2024.

item.title: Iran warns against 'instability' after US strike group arrives
item.description: Iran's president on Tuesday warned U.S. "threats" against the Islamic republic would only cause instability, as a U.S. naval strike group led by an aircraft carrier took up position in Middle Eastern waters.
